item.text:
This pass regenerated the complete audit matrix so the retained artifact reflects every test built during the audit.

**Final audit-tagged matrix** (saved to `audit/cover/audit_matrix.log`)

```
internal/raft (7):  PASS RaftSafetyFuzz, InMemoryLogModel, CandidateProposalIsDroppedOnce,
                    VoteSurvivesRestart
                    FAIL CandidateReadIndexIsDroppedOnce, PeerUpdateDroppedReadIndexes (F2)
                    FAIL UpdateHasUpdateWithDroppedReadIndexes                     (F3)
raftpb (1):         PASS EntryEncodingProperties
root package (14):  PASS DroppedReadIndexIsIdempotent, LargeProposal, LargeProposalTwoNodes,
                    LeaderTransfer, LinearizableReadUnderConcurrency,
                    LinearizableReadAcrossNodes, MultipleClustersOnOneNodeHost,
                    NodeUserReadIndexDispatchLatency, FollowerReadIndex,
                    NodeUserReadIndexTwoTickTimeout, ObserverReadAndPropose,
                    RestartEndurance, WitnessVotesInElection
                    FAIL NodeUserReadIndexOneTickTimeout                            (F1)
```

22 tests in total: 18 passing negative-result/characterisation tests and 4 failing reproductions, all of which are the deliberate defect cases. The report's summary block now lists the complete matrix.

**Findings** (unchanged, all reproduced and all fixed by the minimal patches in `audit/diag-fixes/` with no regressions):

- F1 — `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` in [nodehost.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/nodehost.go:2063) misses the engine wakeup: ~one RTT latency, one-RTT timeouts fail while two-RTT succeed.
- F2 — `handleCandidateReadIndex` in [raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/internal/raft/raft.go:1998) records a dropped ReadIndex twice.
- F3 — `pb.Update.HasUpdate` in [raftpb/raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/raftpb/raft.go:112) ignores `DroppedReadIndexes`.

[report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (557 lines) is the complete handoff: summary with the final matrix and quick-verification commands, overall assessment, three findings with expected/actual/conditions/evidence, fix verification, source-based observations, reviewed-areas catalogue, reproduction inventory and command log. The implementation remains byte-identical to `../source`, and every buildable package passes its own tests sequentially.
